newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady, buyers fret freight rates.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady, buyers fret freight rates.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended steady on Wednesday as buyers continued to fret over high freight rates here and in the Med.
End-users were believed to be interested buyers for early February material, in both markets, but were unwilling to pay up for the high rates.
"Certainly there is interest for early February...The restriction in the market is the shipping," said one source.
A cargo of high paraffinic material was heard but not confirmed placed into the system after the seller's offer of up to high quotes +$5.50 apparently was not met, this source said.
Feb swaps ended up $1 at $218/$219 a tonne, March was unchanged at $212.50/$213.50 and April was notionally valued about 50 cents lower at $208/$209.
Cargoes were seen at $221/$223 cif NWE.
